lead_with.title: A location option, not a partnership
lead_with.text: Finance Montréal helps financial firms **place teams in Montreal**. The question is whether any **operations, risk, compliance, data or support** work linked to their business could sit there.

lead_with.title: New York hours at about half the cost
lead_with.text: Montreal is in the **New York time zone**. A Finance Montréal-commissioned Boyd Company 2026 study puts a 150-FTE financial support operation at about **US$18.9M/yr in Montreal vs US$35.3M in New York**.

lead_with.title: The IFC credit
lead_with.text: Quebec's **International Financial Centre** credit can reach **C$18,000 per eligible employee per year**, including services to a **foreign affiliate**. Eligibility is checked case by case.
